mesocycle.note: Rolling mesocycle, maintained by the Sunday weekly review. `week` counts COMPLETED weeks (>=3 logged sessions); a skipped week freezes the counter (never advances it). Week 4 = deload: gym volume -30-40%, cycling drops to one maintenance rung below current level, long ride shortened to ~2 h Z1-Z2, extra sleep/mobility. After deload, reset week to 1. Paused while a training_block.md is active (the block has its own week structure). Fatigue markers (2+ amber/red days, RPE creep, pain) can pull the deload EARLIER; nothing pushes it later.

cycling.equipment: Shimano SPD (2-bolt) pedals on gravel and road. Indoor: full metrics - power (smart trainer / ERG), HR, GPS. Outdoor: HR + GPS only, no power meter. No auto-sync; rides are logged manually via the dashboard.

ftp.method: Zwift Ramp Test (FTP = 75% of best 1-min power). Retest every 6-8 weeks, min 28 days apart, on a fresh day (not after Mon gym).

zones.note: Percent of FTP. Until FTP is tested, ride hard intervals by RPE and use HR as sanity check (indoor sessions log avg HR).

levels.note: TrainerRoad-style progression levels: index into each session's ordered ladder (1 = first rung). Weekly review moves them: completed all intervals at target power/RPE <= 8 -> +1 next time; partial -> hold; failed or 2+ week cycling gap -> -1.

phase.note: Rotate emphasis every 4-8 weeks (no races planned). base: Thu sweet-spot/threshold progresses, Tue VO2max stays at current level (maintenance dose). build: Tue VO2max progresses, Thu holds at threshold. Long ride stays Z1-Z2 year-round.
phase.outdoor: No power meter outdoors: Saturday long ride is HR + feel (conversational = Z2). Don't judge outdoor rides by power.

GYM_A.label: Gym A — Squat / Horizontal Push / Vertical Pull
GYM_A.note: Keep lower body at RPE ≤ 8 — Tuesday is VO2max. Activation first (~3 min): single-leg glute bridge with 3 s hold at top, 10/side + Copenhagen side plank (bent knee) 1×20–30 s/side.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.cue: Machine load is not comparable to barbell squat.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.cue: Bodyweight until the glute pattern holds, then add bar 20–40 kg as tolerated.

GYM_A.addon: Skills (fresh, before lifting): One Arm Handstand (adv. wall → freestanding) + Wall HSPU. Few shrimp-squat sets in warm-up, low volume.
GYM_A.mobility: 10 min post-session: hip flexor 60 s/side · pigeon or 90/90 60 s/side · couch stretch 60 s/side · open book 10/side · cat-cow ×10.

GYM_B.label: Gym B — Pull / Overhead Press / Arms / Core
GYM_B.addon: Skills (before fatigue): Muscle Up (kip → strict transition) + Front Lever (adv. tuck → one leg).
GYM_B.mobility: Same 10 min routine as Gym A.

GYM_C.label: Gym C — Hinge / Incline Push / Single-leg
GYM_C.note: Saturday is the long ride — trap-bar reps stay quality, not grinders; on amber/red readiness drop to 2 sets. Activation same as Gym A (~3 min): single-leg glute bridge with 3 s hold at top, 10/side + Copenhagen side plank (bent knee) 1×20–30 s/side.

exercises.name: Incline DB press
exercises.cue: Drop ~10% from the reference load if needed.

GYM_C.addon: Skills (low fatigue, technical): Dragon Flag (one leg → straddle) + V-Sit (tuck L-sit → straddle).
GYM_C.mobility: Same 10 min routine as Gym A.

CYCLING_VO2MAX.label: Cycling — VO2max / hill repeats
CYCLING_VO2MAX.purpose: Handle steep climbs, surges, and repeated hard gravel efforts.
CYCLING_VO2MAX.progression: Ordered ladder — do the rung at cycling.levels.vo2max (total hard minutes: 15 → 18 → 20 → 24 → 27 → ~25 high-density). Power @ 106–120% FTP; by RPE 9 on the last interval until FTP is set.
CYCLING_VO2MAX.fueling: TKD: 15–25 g maltodextrin in water 15–30 min before the hard block.
CYCLING_VO2MAX.prep: Hip flexor stretch 30 s/side + leg swings 10/side (~2 min).

CYCLING_THRESHOLD.label: Cycling — Threshold / sweet spot
CYCLING_THRESHOLD.purpose: Improve sustained gravel pace and climbing power.
CYCLING_THRESHOLD.progression: Ordered ladder — do the rung at cycling.levels.threshold (work minutes: 36 → 45 → 32@higher → 40 → 45). Sweet spot 88–94% FTP, threshold 95–100%; by RPE 7–8 sustained until FTP is set. Low-cadence variant (60–70 rpm) can replace any rung 1:1 for gravel-specific strength endurance.
ladder: L1: 3 × 12 min sweet spot / 3 min easy
L2: 3 × 15 min sweet spot / 3 min easy
CYCLING_THRESHOLD.fueling: TKD: 15–25 g maltodextrin in water 15–30 min before.
CYCLING_THRESHOLD.prep: Hip flexor stretch 30 s/side + leg swings 10/side (~2 min).

CYCLING_LONG.label: Long gravel ride
CYCLING_LONG.purpose: Aerobic durability, fat oxidation, technical handling, fueling practice.
options: Optional: tempo finish or climb blocks in the final hour
Optional: rough terrain / gravel handling drills
Electrolytes: 500–700 mg sodium/hr on top of baseline
CYCLING_LONG.fueling: No TKD for Z2. Maltodextrin:fructose 2:1 @ 60–80 g/hr only if deliberately pushing intensity > 90 min.
CYCLING_LONG.prep: Hip flexor 30 s/side · leg swings front/back + lateral 10/side · deep squat hold 60 s · single-leg glute bridge 10/side (~4 min).
CYCLING_LONG.mobility: Same 10 min routine as after a gym session: hip flexor 60 s/side · pigeon or 90/90 60 s/side · couch stretch 60 s/side · open book 10/side · cat-cow ×10.

REST.label: Recovery day
REST.note: Mobility, easy spin/swim/walk, optional easy run 20–45 min Z1–Z2. Nothing hard.

nutrition.style: Ketogenic — very low carbohydrate, high fat, adequate protein. 3 meals/day.
fueling: Pre-gym (optional): 15–20 g maltodextrin in water 15–30 min before — only if energy feels low.
TKD (hard endurance only): 15–25 g maltodextrin 15–30 min before VO2max or threshold work.
Saturday long ride (race-prep only): 60–80 g/hr maltodextrin:fructose 2:1 when deliberately fueling high.

supplements.name: Creatine
supplements.timing: Daily — pre-workout or with a meal

supplements.name: Magnesium glycinate stack
supplements.dose: 320 mg Mg + 30 mg Zn + 2 mg Cu + 4.2 mg B6

nutrition.notes: 25-OH-D bloodwork before sustained high-dose D3. Ashwagandha: cycle 6–8 weeks on, then a break.
